backup_and_restore.requirement: backup policy, backup target, current timezone-aware restore test, and deployment evidence are present

change_control.requirement: release ID, deployed artifact SHA-256, approved change ticket status, and deployment evidence are recorded

connectivity.reason: set PDM_READINESS_PROBE_DATABASE=1 to require a bounded live connectivity check

managed_state_backend.requirement: managed multi-user SQLAlchemy adapter, supported PDM_DATABASE_URL, PDM_MANAGED_STATE_ADAPTER=sqlalchemy, live connectivity probe, and deployment evidence

schema.reason: managed schema check requires a passing live connectivity probe

observability.requirement: PDM_OBSERVABILITY_ENABLED plus metrics exporter, log sink, trace exporter, alert routing, and deployment evidence

production_auth.requirement: PDM_AUTH_MODE=production, valid PDM_API_KEYS from a declared secret provider, a current secret-rotation policy/test, and deployment evidence attestation

prospective_field_validation.requirement: release-bound prospective field evidence with completed follow-up, reconciled outcomes, safety review, operator acceptance, and a non-secret evidence attestation

site_connector.requirement: a site-specific CMMS/ERP connector ID and endpoint are configured and attested

tls_termination.requirement: TLS termination is enabled at the trusted ingress boundary, identified by PDM_TLS_INGRESS_ID, and attested

claim_boundary: This report checks non-secret configuration declarations, bounded managed-state connectivity, structured deployment and field-qualification attestations. It does not certify infrastructure, cybersecurity, compliance, availability, model performance, or field safety.
